quests.title: The Wombarra Tap-Off
quests.blurb: Somebody taps on at Wombarra at half six and never taps off. Same card, 30 months running. Ride the run they ride and find where a person gets off this network without a gate seeing them.

steps.label: ride the run the card rides
the gap in the fence everyone knows about
photograph it before somebody welds it

quests.title: The Miranda Order
quests.blurb: I have made the same order for the same person every morning since I opened at Miranda. Since a wet Monday they have not turned up, and nobody will put it in writing. Go and knock.

steps.label: order one at the Miranda kiosk
the office they walk to, or used to
come back with $62 — I am not running a charity

quests.title: Four Minutes at Riverstone
quests.blurb: The board at Riverstone says four minutes. It has said four minutes since before the merge and it is a lie about a third of the time. Stand under it, time it, and bring me numbers instead of feelings.

steps.label: stand under the board and wait like everyone else
photograph the board saying four minutes
ride the one that finally comes
give me the number

quests.title: Unclaimed at Thornleigh

steps.label: the address on the tag
the two who got there before you
$56 — whatever it is, it is worth that to somebody

quests.title: The Quiet Carriage, Tascott

steps.label: ride the quiet carriage and observe the crime
apply the shame manually
photograph the sign, for the record

quests.title: The Allawah Shortcut
quests.blurb: Every courier has a route that is not on a map and mine goes through Allawah. They have started locking one end. Go and find out whether it is locked forever or just locked today.

steps.label: the end they lock
the long way round, so you understand what it costs

quests.title: Possession at Crows Nest
quests.blurb: Third time at Crows Nest on school holidays. Not kids — kids run. This one walks, and I have stopped filling in the form. I need it stopped before somebody writes a very long report about me.

steps.label: where they come through the fence
the ones who think a hard hat is a costume
photograph the gap so I can put a number on the form

quests.title: The Belmore Regular
quests.blurb: A man drank in my front bar by Belmore for 22 years and then stopped, and every regular in here has gone vague on me at once, which means they know. You are not from here. Go and knock.

steps.label: the house they say he moved to
you cannot ask a favour empty-handed
come back and tell me straight

quests.title: Bay 14, Campsie
quests.blurb: People have started parking on the grass at Campsie because of one abandoned car, and they keep sending a different bloke. Photograph it, and the date on the ticket, so somebody can be embarrassed by it.

steps.label: the car, and the ticket, and the date on it
the two arguing over the grass
$52 in fines nobody is going to collect

quests.title: Whatever Is Under the Grey at Capitol Square
quests.blurb: Council pays me to paint over things and last week I painted over something good. There is another one near Capitol Square that I am scheduled to kill on the first of the month. Photograph it first.

steps.label: the wall, before they get to it
photograph it properly, not a phone-in-a-hurry job
show me

quests.title: The Hill Above Edgecliff
quests.blurb: There is a bench on the hill above Edgecliff I have watched from a moving bus about fourteen thousand times. I am not going to stop — that is not the kind of person I turned out to be. So you go, at knock-off, when the light is worth it.

steps.label: up the hill, the way the road does not go
the view I have never stopped for
$53, because I am paying you for it

quests.title: Contesting It at Macquarie Fields
quests.blurb: Done at Macquarie Fields on school holidays for something that is only an offence if a sign says so, and they keep sending a different bloke. How do you photograph a thing not being somewhere? That is your problem now.

steps.label: where the sign is supposed to be
photograph the absence, which is harder than it sounds
the one who tells you photography is not allowed here

quests.title: The Strip Outside Quakers Hill
quests.blurb: Nobody planted the strip at Quakers Hill. I did, on Thursdays, at two in the afternoon, so nobody would ask. I would like the fifteenth to go badly for council.

steps.label: the strip, which is a garden now
the man with the whipper snipper
photograph it while it still exists

quests.title: Night Fill, Toongabbie
quests.blurb: Started on the long weekend. In off the Toongabbie late train, gone before the first delivery, every time, and it has been like that since the merge. Come in on the late one and watch the loading door.

steps.label: come in on the late one like they do
the loading door nobody watches
whoever is standing in it at two in the morning
$55 of what they took, back

quests.title: The Window Above Ourimbah
quests.blurb: 25 years above Ourimbah. I do not hear the trains any more, which means I hear it instantly when one of them is wrong. Since the first of the month the joins sound different.

steps.label: ride it and listen to the joins
photograph the stretch that sounds wrong
tell me I am not mad

quests.title: Setting Up at Kensington
quests.blurb: Five in the morning at Kensington, in the dark, unloading a van by feel. The bloke in the next bay has started arriving at four to take half my frontage. I need a witness and I need them at four.

steps.label: the bays, at the hour it happens
the bloke with the extra trestle
you will want one at that hour
$57 of frontage, recovered

quests.title: The Clock at Chester Hill
quests.blurb: Somebody set the Chester Hill clock that way on purpose and everyone who knows why is nearly gone. The old crew drink near Sefton on grand final week. Go and ask, and I am the only one who seems to have noticed.

steps.label: the clock, four minutes fast, for the file
to Sefton, where the old crew drink
bring the name back

the street it walks home to
